title: Galois representations ramified at one prime via relative deformation theory
summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and let $\mathbf{G}/\mathbb Z$ be a split connected reductive group with $\operatorname{dim} Z(\mathbf{G})\leq1$. Assume that a split maximal torus of $\mathbf{G}$ admits a cocharacter whose pairing with every simple root is odd, and impose an explicit root-theoretic condition on the reduction of $\mathrm{Lie}(\mathbf{G}^{\mathrm{der}})$ modulo $p$. We construct infinitely many continuous representations $ρ:G_{\{p\}}\longrightarrow\mathbf{G}(\mathbb{Z}_p)$ which are unramified at every finite prime different from $p$ and whose images contain a principal congruence…
